1.text: Uwiteka ategeka urufi runini rumira Yona, maze Yona amara mu nda y'urufi iminsi itatu n'amajoro atatu.

2.text: Maze Yona asengera Uwiteka Imana ye mu nda y'urufi ati

3.text: “Nagize ibyago ntakira Uwiteka aransubiza,Nahamagariye mu nda y'ikuzimu,Wumva ijwi ryanjye.

4.text: Kuko wanjugunye imuhengeri mu nyanja,Umwuzure warangose,Ibigogo byawe n'imiraba yawe byose byarandengeye.

5.text: Ndavuga nti ‘Nciwe imbere yawe,Ariko nzongera kureba urusengero rwawe rwera.’

6.text: Amazi yarantwikiriye angera ku bugingo,Imuhengeri harangose,Urwuya rwanyizingiye mu mutwe.

7.text: Ndamanuka njya mu mizi y'imisozi,Isi n'ibihindizo byayo binkingira ibihe byose,Ariko unkurira ubugingo muri rwa rwobo,Uwiteka Mana yanjye.

8.text: Ubwo umutima wanjye wiheberaga mu nda nibutse Uwiteka,No gusenga kwanjye kwakugezeho mu rusengero rwawe rwera.

9.text: Aberekeza umutima ku bitagira umumaro by'ibinyoma,Baba bimūye ubababarira.

10.text: Ariko jyeweho nzagutambira igitambo n'ijwi ry'ishimwe,Kandi nzahigura umuhigo wanjye,Agakiza gaturuka ku Uwiteka.”

11.text: Nuko Uwiteka ategeka urufi ruruka Yona imusozi.
